title: SPECTRA: Spatiotemporal Personal Exposure Characterization and TRAjectory Analyzer
description: An R toolkit that converts a raw wearable record, one position and one concentration per minute, into a dwell-weighted, microenvironment-resolved exposure estimate for each person, day and 100 m cell. It implements trajectory quality control, capped dwell-time weighting, speed-and-building indoor/outdoor classification, and segmentation by hour, weekday, time of day, season, climate and mobility, through a command-line driver or a Shiny application.
